speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
text: asked the Minister for National Development whether the occupancy cap for HDB jumbo flats can be increased from the current six persons to between eight and 10 persons.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This is to minimise the disamenities caused by overcrowding in our public housing estates and maintain a conducive living environment for all residents.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This is aligned to the occupancy cap for private residential properties of all sizes.
